ModMetaData.name: Tech Progression: World at Your Level
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Keeps the whole world at your colony's tech level.
Features: - Raiders, visitors, caravans and quest pawns arrive only with gear your colony has researched (closest researched replacement, raid strength compensation for lost gear). - Optional "Only crafted": others only use gear kinds your colony has already crafted. - Flamethrowers, explosive, incendiary and EMP weapons only after your colony has made that kind itself. - Mechanitors in human raids bring only mechanoids you have researched (Biotech). - New: arrivals carry nothing better than your colony's own gear – guns, melee weapons (material counts), armor and quality at most as good as the best your colony has crafted, with an optional tolerance. - All factions act at your colony's level (default), or block factions above the world level completely. - Traders, quest rewards and loot are filtered by the world level. - High-tech events (mech clusters, ship parts, toxic spewers...) are replaced with another event of the same kind. Condition causers above the world level are removed, quests are filtered. - Research level readout above the date (progress to the next level, details on hover). - "World" tab: world level, quests, event history with estimates, and diagnostics showing why traders, visitors or raids don't come. Trader guarantee if no caravan arrives for too long. - World level = scenario level + share of finished research per tech tier, with tolerance, time bonus or a manual level. - "Raids" tab: choose which raid types will not happen – threat events (raids, manhunter packs, infestations, mech clusters...), raid strategies (sieges, sappers, breachers...) and arrival modes (drop pods, edge walk-in...), from all mods. - Your own colonists are never affected. - Settings in tabs. English and Czech.
Works great with Smart Colonist Gear (same author): it takes the world level from this mod, so your colonists and the rest of the world share one tech level. With "Only crafted" enabled in both mods, everyone uses only what you have crafted. Both mods also work standalone.
Something broken, or want something added or connected with another mod? Please write it in the comments.
